title: Derivatives
subtitle: Mark, funding, open interest, crowd versus top, day CVD, price versus CVD, print size, order count, unusual readings, liquidation heat, bid share, and 24-hour liquidations for the liquid USDT perpetuals.
gridHint: Each column is a stored hour or UTC day. A blank cell stays blank until every venue has that column, and a missing venue is named. Click a cell to see each exchange.
gridDetailHint: Each exchange shows its own number. A missing exchange is named and is not zero.
gridNoVenues: No exchange breakdown for this cell.
hyperliquidHint: Hyperliquid shows mark, open interest, and the hourly funding rate. Liquidation, tape, and book columns stay blank because that venue does not publish them. Open interest is mark times coin size. The margin is USDC, lined up with the USDT name.
gridBlank: Not a combined total until every venue has this column.
gridMissing: Missing: {{venues}}. That venue is not counted as zero.
heatmapHint: Color is the column you pick. The strongest readings are first. A blank cell is withheld until every venue for that column is fresh.
heatmapBlank: Not a combined total until every venue for this column is fresh.
change24hHint: Change from the stored open-interest sample about 24 hours ago. The cell stays blank when any venue has no sample in that hour.
change24hMissing: No stored sample about 24 hours ago on {{venues}}.
gapScope: Top-trader long percent minus the crowd on {{venues}}.
unusualQuiet: No standout versus this coin's own samples. A short history stays blank too.
withheld: A dash means that column is not a combined total until every venue on the row is fresh.
loadFailed: Could not load the derivatives board
